parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' inside a path that contains 'Examples' and 'SampleApp', which triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record sits under an Examples/ or SampleApp/ directory must be treated as no-action. The duplication of 'MetricRow' in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (package: DebugPanel) and the sample-app file is most likely an intentional local copy kept in the demonstration target to avoid coupling the sample app to the DebugPanel package. Lifting the shared definition into a common package would couple production or sample-app semantics together without clear benefit.
